rec: Combat gear for The Kendal fight

st.t: Use your rope on the boulder outside the Mountain Camp east of Rellekka.
Speak to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp.
s: So what are you doing up here?

sec.n: Go to the centre of the lake

st.t: Head south of Hamal's tent and take some mud from the roots along the edge of the bubbling mud pond.
Pick up the pole north of Hamal's tent.
Follow the path west along the lake to the Tall Tree and use mud on it.
Climb the Tall Tree on the lake north of the camp.
Use your pole or a staff on the clump of rocks.
Use a plank on the flat stone.
Listen to the Shining Pool.
s: So what exactly do you want from me?
That sounds like something I can do.

st.t: Use a plank on the flat stone to return to shore.
Speak to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp.
Speak to Jokul north of Hamal's tent.

Find Svidi, who runs around the woods between Rellekka and the Keldagrim entrance, north-west of the rockslide you climbed to reach the camp. He moves fast, so run to catch him. Choose "Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?": the other option makes him walk off.
s: Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?

st.t: Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka's longhall and ask about the mountain camp.
s: Did it contain vast magical powers?

st.t: Return to the Mountain Camp over the rockslide just south-west of the boulder you tied your rope to. Enter the large tent south-west of Hamal and use a pickaxe on the Ancient Rock inside. If you're wielding the pickaxe, long-press the rock to mine it.
Return to Brundt the Chieftain in the Rellekka's longhall.
Return to Svidi who roams in the forest east of Rellekka.
Go to the top of White Wolf Mountain and pick the Thorny Bushes whilst wearing gloves.
Eat the White Pearl.
Prepare to fight The Kendal (level 70)
Return to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp and tell him about both the food and the people of Rellekka.
Return to the centre of the pool north of the Mountain Camp and listen to it.
Attempt to jump across the flat stone WITHOUT a plank to return to the north shore. Then cut through the trees north east of the lake and enter the cave there. Bring combat gear.
Speak to the Kendal, then kill him.
s: It's just me, no one special.
You look like a man in a bearsuit!
I humbly request to be given the remains.

st.t: Pick up the Corpse of Woman.
Bring the corpse to Hamal.
Pick up 5 muddy rocks from the mountain goat pen in the camp, just north of Hamal's tent near Jokul. They grow back quickly, so you can keep picking up the same rock.
Speak to Ragnar, just south-west of the Tall Tree by the lake.
s: Thank you. I will make sure she's given a proper burial now.

st.t: Return to the centre of the lake and bury the corpse.
Use the Muddy rocks on the Burial Mound at the centre of the Mountain Camp's lake.
